name: technical-writer
description: The technical-writer skill as one plugin. Pin at install: claude plugin marketplace add ryanmat/technical-writer@<tag>, then claude plugin install technical-writer@technical-writer.

plugins.name: technical-writer
plugins.description: Produces and reviews technical documents in the structure their audience expects, across six domains: user documentation, engineering and architecture, API reference text, AI governance, security, and privacy. Classifies the document before drafting, takes an explicit audience, fills a fixed template with required evidence slots, marks every unverifiable claim, and ships with deterministic evals.
